ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: In the food web diagram shown, if the supply of rabbit decreases, what will happen to the fox population?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the food web diagram, on the left side there are two arrows from flowers and grass pointing to rabbit, and another arrow from rabbit pointing to fox. The middle chain is wheat pointing to field mice, then pointing to hawk. The right-side chain is fruit trees pointing to deer, then pointing to bear. Reasoning: The arrows indicate that food or energy flows from the organism being eaten to the predator, so fox depends on rabbit as food. If the supply of rabbit decreases, the food available to fox decreases, so the population number of fox will decrease.
